whatItIs: vqf is an open-source project in the optimization and qubo category. It is maintained by mstechly and primarily looks like a Python codebase. This repository contains implementation of the algorithm presented in the article "Variational Quantum Factoring", by Eric R.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches optimization and qubo workflows in practice.
